commit.message:
LU-20263 test: lfsck_stop -A in sanity-lfsck test_32b

Call lfsck_stop -A in sanity-lfsck test_32b to make sure lfscks on
all nodes stopped, otherwise it may cause test_33 fail with 'partial'
lfsck status.
